title: Workflow 2.0 review-r2 source-output policy correction
description: Truthful repository-evidence bootstrap for centralized mode-specific source-output validation.

requirements.summary: In gpt_tunnel_managed mode, the sole shared GPT Patch Pack v2 validator rejects every forbidden source-repository terminal artifact in files_created, files_modified, or files_deleted.
acceptance: AC1: In gpt_tunnel_managed mode, the sole shared GPT Patch Pack v2 validator rejects every forbidden source-repository terminal artifact in files_created, files_modified, or files_deleted.

requirements.summary: Forbidden paths include any `.gpt-review/evidence` path, any basename `AGENT_RESULT.md`, `agent-result.json`, `evidence.json`, or `completion.json`, and any explicit repository evidence directory declaration.
acceptance: AC2: Forbidden paths include any `.gpt-review/evidence` path, any basename `AGENT_RESULT.md`, `agent-result.json`, `evidence.json`, or `completion.json`, and any explicit repository evidence directory declaration.

requirements.summary: Historical evidence already present in the immutable base tree remains untouched; the validator evaluates only declared patch operation paths and does not scan/reject historical tree contents.
acceptance: AC3: Historical evidence already present in the immutable base tree remains untouched; the validator evaluates only declared patch operation paths and does not scan/reject historical tree contents.

requirements.summary: repository_evidence mode continues to require its canonical evidence_directory and may declare only its exact canonical evidence pair under that directory; unrelated evidence-like paths remain rejected.
acceptance: AC4: repository_evidence mode continues to require its canonical evidence_directory and may declare only its exact canonical evidence pair under that directory; unrelated evidence-like paths remain rejected.

requirements.summary: Builder, runner, standalone validator, and evidence tools all use the same corrected v2 validator; no duplicate policy implementation is introduced.
acceptance: AC5: Builder, runner, standalone validator, and evidence tools all use the same corrected v2 validator; no duplicate policy implementation is introduced.

requirements.summary: Focused tests cover created/modified/deleted forbidden paths, nested basenames, case-sensitive exact names, tunnel completion in source, historical base evidence allowance, and repository_evidence canonical pair acceptance.
acceptance: AC6: Focused tests cover created/modified/deleted forbidden paths, nested basenames, case-sensitive exact names, tunnel completion in source, historical base evidence allowance, and repository_evidence canonical pair acceptance.

requirements.summary: Existing completion schema, task_sha256-only boundary, positional G1..Gn/AC1..ACn semantics, lock schema v2, internal TASK_GATE_CONTRACT_MISMATCH behavior, VERSION 2.0.0, and v2-only tooling remain unchanged.
acceptance: AC7: Existing completion schema, task_sha256-only boundary, positional G1..Gn/AC1..ACn semantics, lock schema v2, internal TASK_GATE_CONTRACT_MISMATCH behavior, VERSION 2.0.0, and v2-only tooling remain unchanged.

requirements.summary: Fresh review-r2 bootstrap evidence is truthful, uses the exact task identity and ordered gates, and preserves all prior evidence directories unchanged.
acceptance: AC8: Fresh review-r2 bootstrap evidence is truthful, uses the exact task identity and ordered gates, and preserves all prior evidence directories unchanged.

requirements.summary: All required gates and exact-SHA CI pass; branch is pushed clean and finalized without merge, release, tag, deployment, connector action, branch deletion, or cross-project mutation.
acceptance: AC9: All required gates and exact-SHA CI pass; branch is pushed clean and finalized without merge, release, tag, deployment, connector action, branch deletion, or cross-project mutation.

gates.name: Focused GPT Patch Pack v2 tests

gpt_static_checks_performed: Delta review of centralized v2 source-output validation.
gpt_runtime_checks_not_performed: Runtime gates are executed by the local agent and captured in the gate run.
